requirements.summary: Replace the single shared-code gate with a sequential three-step admin verification flow that blocks all /admin content until all steps succeed in order.
acceptanceCriteria: When navigating to /admin while signed out, the user sees the existing authentication-required guard messaging and cannot access admin pages.
When navigating to /admin while signed in but not verified, the user is shown Step 1 code entry UI; admin pages are not rendered.
Entering Code #1 correctly unlocks Step 2 entry UI; entering Code #2 correctly unlocks Step 3 entry UI; entering Code #3 correctly grants access to /admin routes.
Users cannot skip steps (e.g., cannot submit Code #3 before completing Steps 1 and 2).
Any incorrect code at a given step keeps the user on the same step and does not grant admin access.
All admin-only backend methods currently protected by the old shared-code session are protected by the new three-step verification state instead.

file_operations.description: Update the /admin guard to require a fully completed 3-step verification state before rendering admin children, and to render the new step UI otherwise. Ensure the guard uses backend capabilities to (a) check current verification status and (b) refresh status after each successful step.

Replace the old single-code verification hooks with multi-step verification hooks that call backend capabilities for verifying the current step and checking whether the caller is fully admin-verified. Update caching so the verification status can be refetched after each successful step.

Replace the single boolean session flag with a session-stored multi-step progress model (e.g., current completed step 0–3). Provide helpers to set/get progress and determine 'fully authorized' only when all steps are completed.

requirements.summary: Implement a step-by-step admin verification screen that shows progress (Step 1/3, 2/3, 3/3) and only allows progressing after each successful entry.
acceptanceCriteria: The admin verification UI presents a single code input at a time for the current step and includes visible progress (e.g., “Step 2 of 3”).
On success for a step, the UI transitions to the next step without requiring a page refresh.
On success for Step 3, the user is routed to or shown the admin dashboard content.
On an incorrect code, the UI shows an error state/message in English and remains on the same step.
The UI does not display, hardcode, or otherwise reveal the codes in any visible text or hints (no placeholders containing the codes).

file_operations.description: Rewrite the existing gate screen to be a 3-step sequential verification UI (single input shown per step) with clear progress indicator, English-only messages, and step transitions after successful verification. Integrate with the updated multi-step admin verification hook(s) and session progress utilities; do not render any admin pages until Step 3 is completed.

requirements.summary: Update admin route protection and related hooks/utilities to track partial progress and authorize only after all three steps are completed, clearing progress on logout.
acceptanceCriteria: AdminRouteGuard only renders children with data-guard-state="authorized" when the caller is fully verified (all three steps complete).
The session/local state keying previously used for single-code verification is replaced or extended to represent the three-step completion state (including partial progress).
Logging out clears any stored admin-verification progress so a subsequent login requires re-verification.
The React Query query key(s) used to cache “admin verification validity” are updated so they correctly reflect the new multi-step state and can be refreshed after each successful step.

file_operations.description: Ensure the guard computes authorization strictly from 'step 3 completed' (not from a legacy boolean), uses updated React Query keys, and keeps the existing signed-out guard messaging behavior intact.

Update React Query queryKey(s) and mutation invalidation/refetching so admin verification validity is refreshed after each successful step. Remove legacy single-code verification call paths from the hook API surface.
Implement session helpers for partial progress (0/1/2/3) and a single 'isFullyVerified()' check. Maintain a clear/cleanup function used on logout.
Update logout behavior to clear the new multi-step admin verification progress from session storage (not just a legacy single-code flag), while keeping existing query cache clearing intact.

requirements.summary: Treat the three admin codes as secrets: do not embed plaintext codes in the frontend bundle, do not log them, and only submit user-entered values to the backend for validation.
acceptanceCriteria: No frontend source files contain the plaintext values of Code #1, Code #2, or Code #3.
Frontend network requests only send the user-entered code string to the backend for verification; the frontend never compares against hardcoded expected values.
Backend error messages are generic enough to avoid leaking the expected codes; returned errors do not echo back the submitted code.
Any telemetry/toast/error handling does not include the code values.

file_operations.description: Ensure the UI never hardcodes, displays, or hints the expected codes (including placeholders/help text), and does not log user-entered codes. Error messages must be generic and English-only.
Ensure hook error handling/toasts do not include submitted code values; only submit the raw user-entered string to the backend verification capability and do not perform any client-side comparisons.
Ensure guard-level messaging and any error handling does not echo submitted codes and does not rely on any hardcoded expected values.

requirements.summary: Make the new three-step flow the only supported UI/logic for admin access and remove/disable remaining single-code gate wording and logic.
acceptanceCriteria: The admin verification messaging is updated to describe a three-step process without referencing an “old shared code” system.
There is no route or screen in the app that still performs the old single-code verification call path as the primary admin authorization mechanism.
All user-facing strings related to admin verification are in English.

file_operations.description: Update all user-facing strings to describe a three-step verification flow (Step 1/3, Step 2/3, Step 3/3) and remove legacy single-code wording such as references to an 'old shared code' system.
Remove or refactor legacy exports/logic that imply a single-code verification model so the only supported path is the 3-step sequential backend-validated flow.
Rename/repurpose storage keys and helpers away from 'shared code verified' semantics so the app no longer implies a single-code session model.
